sourceTitle: Rinnai N-series residential with pump SENSEI installation and operation manual (RUR199i, RUR160i, RUR199e, RUR160e), section 5.6
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not try to light the water heater, do not touch an electrical switch, and do not use a phone in the building. Leave and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off power at the breaker and shut the gas supply before any panel comes off. Gas pressure, the burner, the gas valve, venting and the control board belong to a licensed technician or the manufacturer's technical support.
displayPattern: Diagnostic code 11 on a Rinnai N-series SENSEI tankless water heater with pump (RUR199i, RUR160i, RUR199e, RUR160e).
meaning: No ignition: the heater is not turning on.
causes: Gas shut off at the water heater, the meter, or the propane cylinder
diySteps: Check that the gas is turned on at the water heater, the meter, or the cylinder
If the system is propane, make sure there is gas in the tank
If other gas appliances in the house will not light either, call the gas supplier from outside
proAdvice: If the gas is on and code 11 remains, stop. Rinnai's remaining checks (inlet gas pressure, bleeding air from the gas line, the PC board ground, the flame rod, the igniter, the gas solenoid valves and the orifice) are marked for a qualified professional.
